title: Monitoring proposal
description: A detection enters through this form, never as the response to a parent risk. It must name the parent, the branch, the half of the branch, the decision it supports, and what it cannot see.

half.description: Passive detection changes nothing about likelihood; it sits post-compromise unless it carries response authority.

supports_decision.description: Which response on which branch this monitor supports. A monitor that supports no decided branch is returned.

cannot_see.description: Written down, always. What this monitor structurally cannot observe (e.g. who is at the keyboard; a repository clone with a valid token; data copied locally).

has_response_authority.description: True only for detection that can act (isolate a host, kill a process) — a genuine mitigation on the branch it covers.
